title: RSWP: Robust SO(3)-Equivariant Watermarking for Panoramic Images
abstract: arXiv:2611.29468v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robust watermarking for panoramic imagery is impeded by the topological mismatch between spherical signals and planar representations. Conventional methods fail under $SO(3)$ viewing rotations due to non-linear geometric warping and struggle with viewport extraction, which typically necessitates computationally expensive inverse remapping. To address these challenges, we propose RSWP, a watermarking framework grounded in icosahedral group theory. Leveraging the property that the icosahedral group ($\mathcal{I}_{60}$) serves as the largest discrete subgroup of $SO(3)$, we decompose spherical rotations into tractable local planar rotations and combinatorial facet permutations. Accordingly, we introduce a decoupling architecture that embeds watermarks into discrete facets and a theoretically guaranteed Equivariance-to-Invariance decoding paradigm. translated_abstract: 全景图像的鲁棒水印技术一直受到球面信号与平面表示之间拓扑不匹配的阻碍。传统方法在SO(3)视角旋转下会因非线性几何形变而失效，并且在视口提取方面存在困难，这通常需要计算代价高昂的逆重映射操作。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了RSWP，一个基于二十面体群理论的水印框架。利用二十面体群（I₆₀）作为SO(3)最大离散子群的性质，我们将球面旋转分解为易于处理的局部平面旋转和组合的面片置换。据此，我们引入了一种解耦架构，将水印嵌入到离散的面片中，并提出了一个具有理论保证的“等变到不变”（Equivariance-to-Invariance）解码范式。通过采用等变特征提取器，后接置换不变的排序模……
tldr: 该论文提出基于二十面体群理论的RSWP水印框架，通过将SO(3)球面旋转分解为局部平面旋转和面片置换，实现了对任意视角旋转鲁棒的全景图像水印嵌入与解码。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RSWP, a watermarking framework based on icosahedral group theory that decomposes SO(3) spherical rotations into tractable local planar rotations and combinatorial facet permutations, enabling robust and theoretically guaranteed equivariant watermarking for panoramic images under arbitrary viewing rotations.
